messages:
docs-alex: Heads up — noticed a few inconsistencies in the API ref for GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments. Examples show a 202 response with `deployment_id`, but actual runtime returns 200 and `id`. Also header examples use `x-request-id` lowercase while runtime prefers `Request-Id`.
eng-li: ah thanks for catching. I think this drift happened during the rollout of the async rollback behavior. Runtime now returns 200 for cached lookups; the async path is 202. Example should show 200+id for the normal flow.
docs-alex: Can you paste a minimal curl we can use to confirm? I want to update docs and add a migration note if we changed behavior.
eng-li: sure — try:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Request-Id: abc-123" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/foo-123/deployments
```
Response body (current):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "id": "dep-01Fxyz",
  "status": "active",
  "created_at": "2026-03-10T14:22:00Z"
}
```
sdk-jen: good catch. Our JS/py snippets reference `deployment_id` too — that will break deserialization in clients. I can update SDK example code once docs PR lands. Which file are you planning to edit, alex?
docs-alex: I'll open a tiny PR to docs repo: fix example response -> `id`, adjust status code to 200, unify header name to `Request-Id` (with note that servers accept case-insensitive headers). Also add a short migration note: "Previously examples showed 202/deployment_id; current API returns 200/id for normal lookups, 202 for async operations." Planning to include both examples.
pm-ravi: tiny nit — can we also add a link to the change log /release-notes? The enterprise teams will want to know the behavior change window.
docs-alex: yes will add a reference to release notes and tag the Dedicated customers list.
eng-li: I'll also file an internal ticket to verify all endpoints' header examples for casing and `Request-Id` usage. If we update examples, we should ensure the header is consistently shown as `Request-Id` in docs and SDKs.
sdk-jen: after the docs PR, I'll create a follow-up PR in the SDK repo updating examples and adding a minor migration note in the changelog. Will ping here when ready.
deploy-bot: PR #4287 (docs): Updated deployments examples — awaiting review :eyes:
docs-alex: @eng-li @sdk-jen I linked PR #4287 in the ticket. Can folks review? Quick approvals please — it's a small example change but important for clients.
eng-li: reviewing now, will comment if any infra concerns. :thumbsup:
sdk-jen: lgtm, thanks for including both 200 and async 202 examples. Saves us from future confusion.
docs-alex: thanks all — merging after one more approval. I'll post the final release-note link here once merged.
